message.content:
The cost of renting an apartment in New York varies widely depending on the borough, neighborhood, size, and amenities. As of early 2024, average monthly rents are roughly:

| Borough | Average rent (1‑bedroom) | Average rent (2‑bedroom) |
|---------|--------------------------|--------------------------|
| Manhattan | $3,200–$4,500 | $4,800–$7,000 |
| Brooklyn | $2,400–$3,800 | $3,600–$5,500 |
| Queens | $1,800–$2,900 | $2,700–$4,200 |
| Bronx | $1,400–$2,300 | $2,100–$3,200 |
| Staten Island | $1,200–$1,900 | $1,800–$2,800 |

These figures are averages; specific listings can be higher or lower. For a more precise estimate, you could use a rental calculator or consult local listings.
